Location comments:
Redwood National Park was created in 1968. It was formed to augment the holdings of three California State Parks. 
The state and national lands are managed jointly by the  California Department of Parks and Recreation and the National Park Service.  The three state parks are Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park, Del Norte Coast Park and Prarie Creek Redwood State Park.
